name: EHRSQL
intro: EHRSQL是针对电子健康记录的实用文本到SQL基准，通过收集222名医院工作人员的提问并关联MIMIC-III和eICU数据库，评估QA模型在结构化EHR数据上的SQL生成和时间表达式理解能力。
org: KAIST, Seoul Women's University, Konyang University College of Medicine
build_method: 医院问卷, 问题与时间模板, 人工SQL标注, 数据库实例化, 人工与机器释义质检
eval_feature: 真实医院需求, 时间敏感查询, 不可回答题拒答, 可执行SQL
scale: 24,411个问题-SQL对, 230个模板, 2个EHR数据库, 222名医护受访者
build_method_en: Hospital poll, question and time templates, manual SQL annotation, database instantiation, human/machine paraphrase QA
eval_feature_en: Real hospital needs, time-sensitive queries, unanswerable-question abstention, executable SQL
intro_en: EHRSQL is a practical text-to-SQL benchmark for electronic health records. It collects questions from 222 hospital staff and links them to the MIMIC-III and eICU databases to evaluate QA models' SQL generation and temporal expression understanding on structured EHR data.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the NeurIPS 2022 EHRSQL paper arXiv:2301.07695 Sections 3–4, Figure 3, and Tables 2–5, plus the official release. The diagram records 1,742 poll utterances from 222 Konyang University Hospital staff; three patient scopes; 230 templates split into 174 answerable and 56 unanswerable; paired global, within-event, and exact NL–SQL time filters; manual SQL annotation by four graduate students over five months with a reviewer per database; nested-query guidance for MIMIC-III and eICU; cost-table addition, 2100–2105 time shifting, and cross-patient value shuffling; three-stage operation/time/condition instantiation; execution requiring at least one valid answer; human and machine paraphrasing with RoBERTa/perplexity/edit-distance filters and unanimous three-group crowd approval; 24,411 pairs; 9.3K/1.1K/1.8K splits per database with 33% unanswerable only in validation/test; abstention; and F1ans/Pexe/Rexe/F1exe.
